text: Decent enough game for what it is, but god damn is it so aggressive on getting you to waste money. I hadn't played for a good couple of years, but this is just ridiculous now...or at least it feels so much worse on the money grabbing front. The amount of popups and "events" is just ridiculous. You end up clicking close a good 3 to 4 times after every level has been completed.

If you want to play this game for free, it gets frustrating. They put levels in where it is extremely difficult to do the task unless you are prepared to buy rewards/play time. I have played without spending a penny, but it means that there periods where I cannot play until time has passed to build up lives again. No idea if in the 'competitions' I am playing against people buying tools/lives/rewards.

Haven't played candy crush in a while, so downloaded it to play again, wish I hadn't. If you get an unlimited lives candy etc bonus you'll waste half of it skipping prompts and reminders to play side games. Power ups are in effectual and have a habit of going off by themselves. Some levels are clearly designed so you fail so you have to pay to win. The worst thoigh is the constant and I mean constant push to get you to spend money after every single level. Uninstalled again.

I have been playing this game for a long time and absolutely love it. My only problem is loading the game, get so far then disappears. Can take 5-6 attempts till it loads. Also when I'm playing, the same thing can happen especially when I watch the adverts for extra moves at the end of the game. Thought it was my phone but that's new and it happens on my second phone too. So ANNOYING...still love the game though.

I would give this 5 star but I'm getting so annoyed now Nearly everytime I'm in game and get a call or something, if I've just finished the level, I go back to the game and it throws me out! I have to redo that level plus I get bounced out of candy royale and I lose my Streak bonuses. This seriously needs sorting. If you haven't physically watched yourself walk to the next level... you lose it. It should save where you left off. Not when you reach the next level. I've lost so many gold bars now!

I am at level 1045. It says new level coming soon. When the new levels will comes? I can't play my favourite game. ..😕 Edit 26/09/23: Not the first time being annoyed with the game developer! Bad, Bad, Bad! Several issues with connection, paying options and bonus claims! I am really frustrated with the daily purchase issues, resulting in changing my choices (often waisting money) when purchasing a deal! Constantly prompting purchasing, disgusting!

not the most mentally challenging of "puzzle" games but I have a subscription to Google play points and you can get free stuff for certain apps which allow you to get a free in app purchase for up to £5 (or €5/$5 depending on what country you're in) each offer is available for a set time then they'll charge them. You're subscription has to be active and up to date with payments or you won't be able to use the boosters and special offers but you will still get points for in app purchases

Good game, only issue is extra moves purchased and not used aren't carried over to next level, for example spend an amount like £4 on X amount of extra moves to finish a level, only a few are used the rest are taken off. To make it fair, moves purchased and paid for by the player should be added on to the next level. I'm reluctant to buy extra moves because of this...

Consider yourself deleted.... if I can't pass a level with 5 lives I'm not playing... shame because it was fun. I've noticed at certain times the game really helps you along, pass levels really fast, then nothing. I want to play at the time I choose not the game. The fish power up like other games it useless, doesn't help, unless the game wants to keep you playing at that time it chooses, then they hit what's needed.

Love the game but the bomb doesn't seem to have as good as a effect as it used to. Also I'm a bit, a lot peeved with the candy crush games, i play candy crush saga, soda and friends. I changed my phone, but backed everything up first and still lost all my gold, things I'd bought and to top it all off it lost my progress/levels, I was in the thousands and had to start again from level 1 and nobody could help me get all my purchased items or levels back 😡😡

Spoilt by the fact I've had 3 friends help me to the next part of the game and all 3 have been cancelled so I still have to wait might not bother playing again. I'm disappointed 😞 and in the last few minutes I have lost 30 minutes of freeplay for playing every day within 5 minutes the game closes down. Its after midnight so I try again I get the free minutes and within 5 minutes closes again. RUBBISH!!!!!!!!!

You smash through the first 40 - 80 levels in about a day. After that, the levels are designed to be effectively impossible, with random arrangements, so you fail with only a few moves to go, to try and force you to spend money. Moves are always no where near where you need them to be, resulting in wasted moves. When you hit the 100's you'll pass a level maybe once every 2 or 3 days unless you spend money on lives and power ups constantly.

Skip/cancel buttons PLEASE. I don't need to sit through a long animation teaching me how to make a fish every single time the kimmie goes fishing event turns up just for a massive fish to constantly appear on my screen and cover the gameplay. I will not buy deluxe pass. Stop making it so that the "purchase" button is my only option other than restarting the app. That's scummy. I do no care for the golden tickets, nor the excessive animation asking me to buy your product.

For the last 7 days it tells me that I have no Internet connection even though my internet is connected and working perfectly. The game is working but I can't log in, collect anything that I've won or the daily bonuses also can't ask friends or send lives, can't access store, the Q&A section is useless. I've uninstalled the whole thing losing over 4000 levels! The new price raises are just ridiculous!

Good game and very addictive - but would be a great help if you got the opportunity to empty your pig when full. I've upgraded mine twice but it's been full for over a week now - with no means of emptying it. Very frustrating. Update: STILL unable to empty the piggy bank. Emailed them - no reply to either this review or the emails. One can only assume it's 'a glitch' designed to 'encourage' gamers to buy gold instead of using the gold already won - but permanently unable to access.

If you like this sort of game, it's one of the best. Lots of different boosters to make, colorful, good fun. The only downside is that while there aren't the constant ad breaks as many other free games have, there are just as many in game pop ups at times - look at this new offer, ooh, hard level here's another offer, why not invite your friends, etc. Otherwise, good fun!

love this game but since the last update there has been huge problems with the game freezing. only way to fix this is to uninstall and reinstall the game. progress is saved once you log back in but all boosters that have built up are gone. starting to become too much hassle to play, next time this happens it will be uninstalled for good!

it's not like it used too be. It crashes in the middle of playing, then takes all your sodas. Boosters aren't worth using most times, they position all the boosters in spots where they all explode together. Some adds have 3 &4 ads into one & then easily causes you to go to the site, & lose everything etc... it should be investigated for scams. I only play it to witness the scams, who knows what could happen if someone needs the right proof, because this is done on purpose.

Not a game! What Kings calls a game are just instant gratification animations where constantly the whole screen explodes in pretty colors. With the purpose of filling the time between lengthly animation that try to trigger you to spend money. It is terrible hiw they try to give you the feeling of missing out or falling behind if you don't buy what they advertise. NEVER LET YOUR CHILDREN HAVE THIS APP ON THEIR DEVICE! I will make sure no app at all from Kings will ever be on my kids devices!

Fun to play dnt like the prices of in app items tho its a game and ion think the cost of stuff should cost more then a dollar ea. Esp. Since ur bonus perks are extremely sm. Which makes it hard to level up wish that was diff. And more perk points given per purchases and cost lowered ik id buy more often if they were reduced n perks increased
